limitations: No real Firebase staging auth/account sign-in, login latency, or EdgeOne production browser was tested.
AI translation endpoint requires EdgeOne MAKERS_MODELS_KEY / AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY; optional public access is disabled by default.
User-entered names are translated for DISPLAY only, never stored or used as identity keys; editable input values remain original.
H114 185-feature parity and badminton 60 contracts are not certified end-to-end; legacy H91 language test already failed on unmodified H114.
Tests/h109_release_architecture.js and h108_release_parity.js are pinned to historic release ids and cannot be counted as H115 release failure without updating expected tags.
EdgeOne WAF/rate limits and privacy approval needed before optional anonymous translation endpoint is enabled.
